summary: Verified batch of 4 bugs from founder QA report. BUG #1 (fetch_file 6-arg TypeError across ship/loop pipeline): all 62 backend tests pass across test_iter170_codebase_browse.py (6/6, including new regression test_file_happy_path_exercises_real_fetch_file that exercises the REAL unmocked fetch_file with only httpx.AsyncClient.get mocked), test_iter334_auto_qa_agent.py (25/25), test_response_confidence_mismatch_gate.py (11/11 including 2 new tests for descriptive-question and legit-action-verb branches), and test_iter212m6_tool_reliability_full.py (20/20). Ran a static AST scan of the entire /app/backend/ tree for calls to fetch_file / _get_branch_head / _get_commit_details / gh_fetch / _gh_fetch_file / gh_api_fetch_file and found ZERO remaining call-count mismatches. Live curl smoke on preview backend confirms the /api/aurem-dev/cto/projects/{id}/file endpoint returns a clean 401 (missing auth), 404 ({"detail":"Project not found"}), or 404 ({"detail":"File not found: README.md"}) — never a Cloudflare 502 nor a Python TypeError-shaped body. Backend supervisor logs show no TypeError entries. As explicitly flagged by the main agent, this sandbox has NO working GitHub PAT/App credentials (every test project's PAT is expired — confirmed live: /tree endpoint returns {"detail":"GitHub PAT invalid or expired"} HTTP 401), so a literal end-to-end successful GitHub commit could NOT be produced. This is an accepted, documented limitation, not an unresolved gap. BUG #2 (confidence gate widened): unit tests pass proving descriptive questions mentioning file/api/code/etc now trigger the mismatch check while legit fix requests using action verbs (fix/add/broken/debug/refactor) still pass through. BUG #3 (preview file viewer): same root cause as #1, covered by same test suite; live curl to /file endpoint returned clean 404 JSON (not Cloudflare error). Playwright preview-tab click-through was attempted but the current dashboard view didn't expose a file-tree entry to click (all connected demo repos show 'GitHub access revoked' banner — expected in sandbox). BUG #4 (natural-language Loop trigger): frontend source confirmed — chatTextUtils.js exports LOOP_OPT_IN_RE and detectsLoopOptIn, ChatPanel.jsx send() imports detectsLoopOptIn and gates on execMode !== LOOP + isLoopUnlockedSync(). Playwright login as founder (test@aurem.dev) succeeded, typed 'run this as a loop', pressed Enter — message dispatched without silent 120s+ hang, input cleared, no console errors captured. Toast selectors returned empty at read time (likely auto-dismissed by the ~4s wait; toast id 'loop-opt-in-auto-switch' is fire-and-forget with default duration). Non-entitled-user branch (Free/Starter) was NOT verified — no non-entitled preview credentials are available in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (qa-free-339k@aurem.dev listed but not verified; qa-scan-bot is a prod account).
critical_code_review_comments: ChatPanel.jsx is 5438 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Non-blocking but worth a future split (send() / loop wiring / ship modal handlers are natural seams).

Loop opt-in toast id 'loop-opt-in-auto-switch' is fire-and-forget with default duration; if visibility verification is desired in future automated tests, expose a data-testid on the sonner toast wrapper (or persist a small chat-log breadcrumb) so tests don't race the toast timeout.

context_for_next_testing_agent: AST scan pattern used: walked /app/backend, matched Call nodes whose func name is in {fetch_file,_get_branch_head,_get_commit_details,gh_fetch,_gh_fetch_file,gh_api_fetch_file} and compared positional arg count to expected (5 for fetch_file family, 4 for _get_branch_head/_get_commit_details). Zero mismatches. If this bug ever recurs, that same scan is the fastest way to catch it. Sandbox has NO working GitHub credentials; do NOT chase 401 'PAT invalid or expired' on /tree — it is expected. To exercise BUG #4 non-entitled branch, main agent needs to either seed or verify a Free/Starter test account.
rca of the issue: BUG #1: services/github_api_writer.py's fetch_file/_get_branch_head/_get_commit_details are self-contained (own httpx.AsyncClient inside), but 5+ call sites across cto_projects.py, loop_engine.py, loop_execute.py, qa_matrix.py, mode_d_debugger.py were still passing a pre-created client as the first positional arg — carryover from an older signature. Python raised TypeError: fetch_file() takes 5 positional arguments but 6 were given, which surfaced as an ingress 502. Fix: strip the extra client arg at every call site; loop_execute also gained its previously-missing branch/ref arg. Regression prevention: new test_file_happy_path_exercises_real_fetch_file exercises the REAL function with only httpx mocked, so any future signature drift blows up in CI instead of prod. BUG #2: _FIX_INTENT_TOKENS previously included descriptive nouns (file, api, code, ...) that caused innocent questions like 'what does the payment api do?' to bypass the mismatch gate. Narrowed to true action verbs only; _SIMPLE_WORD_LIMIT bumped 10→20 to widen the hard-rule check. BUG #3: same root cause as #1 (the get_project_file route in cto_projects.py was one of the fixed sites). BUG #4: chatTextUtils.js added LOOP_OPT_IN_RE mirroring backend services/loop_intent._LOOP_OPT_IN; ChatPanel.jsx send() now detects the phrase pre-dispatch, switches execMode to LOOP if entitled and starts runLoopPlan, or shows a clear toast if not entitled — no more silent 120s hang.
